parts.visual:
A PM at a social media company looks at the data. They realize that if they change the algorithm to show users angry, polarizing political content, engagement goes up 400%, and ad revenue doubles. If they show users calm, educational content, revenue drops. The CEO tells the PM to optimize for revenue. The PM's decision will literally alter the mental health of 50 million teenagers.

The Responsibility:
1. The Power of Code: Product Managers are no longer just building tools; they are the architects of human psychology. An algorithm change in Silicon Valley can cause a political revolution in South America.
2. The Ethical Wall: A true PM must protect the user, even if it means fighting the CEO. If a product is mathematically profitable but socially destructive, the PM has a moral obligation to refuse to build it.
parts.audio: Technology is not neutral. Every button, every push notification, and every algorithm is an active manipulation of human behavior. If you do not have a strong ethical core, the pressure of corporate capitalism will force you to build monsters.

questions.question: What is the danger of optimizing purely for 'Engagement'?
options: The Outrage Machine. Human psychology is hardwired to react to fear and anger. If a PM tells an AI algorithm to 'Maximize Time on Screen', the AI will quickly learn that showing users terrifying, enraging content keeps them scrolling forever.
The servers will crash from too much use.
questions.correct_answer: The Outrage Machine. Human psychology is hardwired to react to fear and anger. If a PM tells an AI algorithm to 'Maximize Time on Screen', the AI will quickly learn that showing users terrifying, enraging content keeps them scrolling forever.
questions.explanation: Engagement is a metric, not a moral value.

questions.question: Listen to the former PM of a major tech giant. Why did they resign?
questions.tts_text: My team designed the 'Infinite Scroll' feature. We completely removed the bottom of the page so the brain never gets a signal to stop reading. It was a massive success for the company. But I realized I had built a digital slot machine that was destroying attention spans. I couldn't sleep.
options: Because they didn't get a bonus.

The Attention Economy. Many tech products are explicitly designed using casino psychology (variable rewards, infinite scroll) to addict the user. The PM realized that stealing human attention for ad revenue was ethically indefensible.
Because the code was too hard.
questions.correct_answer: The Attention Economy. Many tech products are explicitly designed using casino psychology (variable rewards, infinite scroll) to addict the user. The PM realized that stealing human attention for ad revenue was ethically indefensible.
questions.explanation: You cannot build a casino and pretend it is a library.

questions.question: What is 'Algorithmic Bias'?
options: When a PM trains an AI model on historical data that contains human prejudice. For example, if an AI is trained to screen resumes using 10 years of data from a sexist company, the AI will automatically reject women, thinking it is 'optimizing'.
When the algorithm prefers certain colors.
questions.correct_answer: When a PM trains an AI model on historical data that contains human prejudice. For example, if an AI is trained to screen resumes using 10 years of data from a sexist company, the AI will automatically reject women, thinking it is 'optimizing'.
questions.explanation: AI is just a mirror reflecting our own historical flaws.

questions.question: How can a PM practically enforce ethics against a CEO who only wants profit?
options: Long-term alignment. The PM must argue that unethical behavior (like Dark Patterns or destroying user trust) will eventually cause a massive PR disaster, government lawsuits, and catastrophic churn. Ethics is the ultimate long-term business strategy.
questions.correct_answer: Long-term alignment. The PM must argue that unethical behavior (like Dark Patterns or destroying user trust) will eventually cause a massive PR disaster, government lawsuits, and catastrophic churn. Ethics is the ultimate long-term business strategy.

pairs.match: Optimizing for screen time, which accidentally prioritizes anger and fear
A casino-like UX design that removes the brain's natural stopping point
When an AI learns and automates historical human prejudices
Proving to the CEO that unethical design will eventually destroy the company
